sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed 
on monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block

The hydrogen electrolyzing plant generates hydrogen and Oxygen by the 
electrolysis of water. The installation will be constructed in order to fulfill 
the following functions
Delivery of hydrogen of 0.7 MPa constant pressures for cooling the generators
Filling of bottles with High-pressure hydrogen

Safe discharge of Oxygen into the Atmosphere, if it should not be filled into 
Oxygen bottles

sections.text:
Circuit of 
electrolyte

For the 
electrolytic process a 28% solution of potassium hydroxide (KOH) will be used as 
an electrolyte. The electrolyte is prepared in a dissolving vessel of carbon 
steel, into which a pump pumps it from the electrolyzer. This pump is of cast 
iron. The vessel has a withdrawable basket for dissolving the KOH

Circuit of 
feed water

The 
dematerialized water needed for the electrolytic process is supplied by the 
piping into the equalizing and storing vessel. From here, the water is lead into 
the electrolyzer and / or into the dissolving vessel of the electrolyte. The 
vessel is made of PVC

The 
conductivity of the demi-water will be continuously measured at the intake. 
Conductance = (2μs/cm)
Circuit of hydrogen

The produced hydrogen is delivered into the gas 
reservoir. The reservoir will have a gas inlet and outlet and a water inlet and 
overflow. The level regulator controls the volume of hydrogen production by 
adjusting the electric current of the rectifier. A four-stage compressor cooled 
by air to 20 MPa outlet pressure presses the hydrogen from the reservoir. Into 
the suction part of the compressor, a filter for trapping eventual traces of KOH 
is inserted. The filter body is of carbon steel, the candle filter of 
polypropylene. The filling station will be at the same time for filling four 
high-pressure steel bottles with hydrogen to 20 MPa final pressures
KOH used as an Eectrolyte

Quality of KOH used for electrolyzer : 88-90%
Total alkalinity : 
Max. 0.3 % K2CO3
Max. 0.001 % CT
Packed in iron sheet barrels
Technical Data of Rectifier

Power rated : 58.52 kw
Rated ac voltage : 380 +/- 10% volts
Rated ac current : 112A
Rated frequency : 50 +/- 5%
Number of phases : 3
Rated dc voltage : 13.3 v
Rated dc current : 4400 A
Ambient temperature : 40 C
Cooling
Forced air by built in fans
Construction and components location
The rectifier consists of three compartments

items: Main cabinet
Control compartment

The main cabinet houses the following items:
 Main transformer (T1) and transformer thermistors 
 Scr`s assembly heatsinks, scr`s (scr-6) & SCR fuses (F1-F6)
 SCR`s fuse trigger actuator micro switch (MSI-6)
 DC shunt (50 mv = 5.000A)
 Main fans (B1)
 Surge suppression networks (R1-R6) (C1-C6)
 Bleeder resistor (R10)

The control panel houses the following items:
 Control, trigger board and driver board
 Phasing transformer
 Control transformer
 Voltage adjust potentiometer, current adjust pot
 Power available
 Rectifier terminal block
 Fan contactor and overload
 Fan fuses
 Control primary fuses
 Control secondary fuses
 DC over current relay
 Rectifier on light
 DC voltmeter
 DC ammeter
